A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''herald''' was aboard [[Harrar]]'s [[Harrar's priestship|priestship]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. There, the herald brought a [[villip]] to [[Nom Anor]] when one of the [[Executor/Legends|Executor's]] [[Nom Anor's underling|underlings]] contacted him.
